Subject: Email practices

Dear John,

I hope you’re doing well. I wanted to remind you about effective email practices at Project Zenith Inc. and request your assistance with a small task.

- Use a clear subject line that reflects the purpose of your message.
- Keep your wording concise and maintain a polite, professional tone.
- Proofread your email for accuracy and ensure all necessary attachments are included.

As part of improving our communication process, I kindly ask you to connect with the PR manager to verify your details and ensure everything is up to date on our internal records. The PR manager’s email is contact@contact.com.

The body
